stem: A recirculating system keeps reservoir EC stable while individual ions drift substantially between analyses. What is the strongest interpretation?
choices: Stable EC proves nutrient composition is unchanged
Bulk EC can remain similar while ion composition changes, so recirculating systems require composition and mass-balance awareness beyond one EC number
Ion analysis is unnecessary in recirculation
rationale: EC is a bulk conductivity measurement rather than a full composition analysis. Water uptake and selective ion uptake can change nutrient ratios while total conductivity appears stable.
